The following list is incomplete. You can help the Hay Day Wiki by adding missing information.


The collection book

The collection book lets players keep track of options they've tried for each part of their farmhouses, trucks and roadside shops.

Note: It is not known with certainty that Maggie requires the same medium of exchange (coins, vouchers, diamonds) every time, nor whether she charges constant prices. It is known that some items may be offered for free as well as at the listed price -- probably as part of the initial tutorial.
